valuation.peRouteNote: the two P/E routes differ (market cap over net profit 11.37, price over EPS 12.57); the net-profit row reconciles with the filing's own profit before tax less tax, so the EPS row is the one filed in a different unit
valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: the same company (emaarmisrfordevelopmentsae) is served under two keys, EMFD P/E 11.94 and EMFD.CA P/E 12.07, and they disagree; one market capitalisation cannot be two, so neither multiple is verified. Every market-based multiple of this security is built on that market cap, so none of them is a valuation. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.pePeriodNote: P/E and the income multiples stand on FY2025, the newest annual earnings on file, not on H1 2026, the newest period on file, which is an interim and is not annualised
valuation.note: P/E stands on FY2025, the newest annual earnings on file; the statement and the ratios above are H1 2026, an interim and not annualised.
valuation.pegFormula: P/E divided by the growth rate of earnings, the growth rate expressed in percent
valuation.pegGrowthBasis: net profit compound annual growth of 10.34 percent a year from FY2021 (3.941e+09) to FY2025 (5.84158e+09), over 4 years
valuation.peEpsSource: net profit for FY2025 divided by the shares on file
valuation.pbFormula: current price / book value per share, where book value per share = total equity / shares outstanding
valuation.pbEquityRow: total_equity on the balance sheet for FY2025
valuation.pbSharesSource: the same 5.44693e+09 shares behind the market capitalisation (static_data\market_EGX.json)
valuation.psFormula: current price / revenue per share, where revenue per share = revenue / shares outstanding
valuation.psRevenueRow: the income statement's revenue line for FY2025, read from the row labelled 'Revenue'
valuation.psSharesSource: the same 5.44693e+09 shares behind the market capitalisation (static_data\market_EGX.json)
